title: "Experience 💼 🎓"

I'm a **Research Professional at the [IMAGINA Research Center](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/), Universidad de los Andes**. I work on a pre-registered RCT on violence detection and social norms, on working papers about childhood adversity, and on the data behind several public indicator dashboards.

Beyond the code, I've been a **Teaching Assistant** in Economic Analysis of Public Policy (M.A. level) for four semesters, and I've run **technical workshops** with government teams and civil society organizations. I document my pipelines and codebooks so other teams can pick them up and reuse them, because well-documented work is how evidence actually reaches policy decisions.

## Experience (Brief Overview)

- **Research Professional**\
  *IMAGINA Research Center, Universidad de los Andes \| Jun 2023 – Present*\
  Co-led the design of a **pre-registered RCT** on violence detection and social norms, estimated **SEM and mediation models** for papers on childhood adversity, and built **indicators for public dashboards**.

- **Policy Data Analyst and Consultant**\
  *Secretaría de Integración Social, Bogotá District Government \| Jun 2025 – Feb 2026*\
  Led a team of 4–6 people reviewing **51 district social policies**. Used **large language models** in a Python pipeline to classify and summarize policy documents, and ran workshops with stakeholders in 20 localities.

- **Research Analyst**\
  *Vice-Presidency of Research & Creation, Universidad de los Andes \| Mar 2022 – May 2023*\
  Designed a **Theory of Change and a cost-effectiveness analysis** for the Juanfe Foundation, and harmonized **VACS survey data from 17 countries** (CDC and USAID).

- **Research Assistant Intern**\
  *Alberto Lleras Camargo School of Government, Universidad de los Andes \| Aug 2021 – Feb 2022*\
  Reviewed causal evidence and coded qualitative data on **teenage pregnancy, child protection, and violence** against children and women.
